newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine banks slide on Victorias debt problem.
newsitem.headline: Philippine banks slide on Victorias debt problem.

text.p: Shares of three major Philippine banks fell on Friday at midsession on reports they had substantial exposures to the financially-troubled Victorias Milling Co Inc, brokers said.
Victorias announced late on Thursday that it had negotiated for a moratorium with 32 local and foreign banks on debts amounting to $167 million.
Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co Inc (Metrobank) slipped 10 pesos to 685 pesos, Philippine National Bank, down five pesos to 300 pesos, and Bank of the Philippine Islands, slid two pesos to 181 pesos.
But an analyst at a foreign securities firm said he expected the banking counters to recover next week since the problem was limited to Victorias and not to the whole industry.
Other banking issues were either unchanged or slightly higher. Security Bank was unchanged at 55.50 pesos, while Philippine Commercial International Bank was 2.50 pesos higher at 382.50 pesos.
